Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a calculation error when comparing the lifespans of the two individuals. Based on the data retrieved in previous steps, Antonio Caggiano lived from 1889 to 1979 (89 years and ~9 months), while Hardyal Singh lived from 1928 to 2018 (89 years and ~8 months). The Planner incorrectly calculated Caggiano's lifespan as 89.25 years and Singh's as 90.25 years, leading to the wrong conclusion that Singh lived longer. In reality, Caggiano lived approximately 0.17 years (about 2 months) longer than Singh. This error stems from a miscalculation of the duration between the birth and death dates provided by the WebSurfer.
